The MusicXML files in this folder were written by hand for Composer's tests. They contain only
public-domain melodies (traditional tunes, and Jane Taylor's 1806 words to "Twinkle, Twinkle")
or a few notes made up for testing, and are released into the public domain (CC0 1.0).

The review-*.musicxml files were written by Composer's reviewer in the shapes MuseScore, Dorico,
Finale and Sibelius export, for these tests. They too hold only public-domain music (traditional
tunes, Beethoven's "Ode to Joy" theme, John Newton's 1779 words) or made-up test notes, and are
released into the public domain (CC0 1.0).
review-bad-charref, review-billion-laughs and review-truncated are deliberately broken files from
the same review, for the reader's error messages.
